content.rendered:
“Oh Boy!” was originally written and recorded by Sonny West, but it was Buddy Holly and the Crickets’ version that broke through to become a hit (peaking at number 10 in the US) and an enduring classic.

Bruce counts Buddy Holly among his big influences, so it’s not surprising that Bruce performed “Oh Boy” a few times during the Darkness on the Edge of Town tour.

Here’s the last performance from that tour, from the August 4, 1978 show in Charleston, West Virginia.

You’re probably familiar with Buddy Holly’s version already, so here’s the Sonny West original.

Oh Boy
First performed: July 29, 1978 (St. Petersburg, FL)
Last performed: March 17, 1996 (Dublin, Ireland)

© May 17, 2018

excerpt.rendered: Bruce covered Buddy Holly’s hit “Oh Boy!” three times on the Darkness tour.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Rave On
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce Springsteen idolized Buddy Holly, and Gary Busey portrayed him on screen. Together, they paid tribute to the late rocker, covering one of his greatest hits in the summer of '78. Take a listen inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Not Fade Away
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce covered "Not Fade Away" as far back as 1971 and as recently as last summer. It's always at the ready for an impromptu team-up--watch some of best ones inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll of the Dice: I’m Gonna Treat You Right (Wild Kisses)
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: A true flash in the wild: the E Street Band rehearses a one-time-only performance of a lost, light Springsteen original.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll of the Dice: Outside Looking In
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: In which Bruce wears his influence so much on his sleeve that it's practically a "Peggy Sue" tattoo.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Come On, Let’s Go
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce and Cats on a Smooth Surface cover Ritchie Valens' very first hit.

jetpack-related-posts.title: I Fought the Law
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: In their first and only on-stage team-up, Don Henley and Bruce Springsteen covered an early rock classic.
